author: mark
text:
Alignment audit on bl-6bd1 worktree:

- Tool calls land as commits (§2.2 / §3.3): commit-per-side-effect
  serialized for worktree-modifying tools; read-only tools produce
  per-call output.json only. Documented and exercised by
  prompt::tests::multi_step.
- Tools return synchronously (§2.5 'Every tool returns synchronously',
  line 180). Async-via-handle is documented as v0.4 work.
- CLI dispatcher (§3.4): tool resolution order in
  src/prompt/tool/spawn.rs:96 follows '<harness-root>/tools/
  lernie-tool-<name>' → PATH → 'lernie tool <name>' in-process,
  matching the §3.3 spec.
- Binary + schema + skill triple (§3.3): bash and read_file each
  ship the triple; schemas in schemas/tools/, SKILL.md under
  skills/, in-process subcommand in src/prompt/tool/builtin/.
- No banned-term violations: 'turn', 'compression', 'session', bare
  'call' all absent in code/docs except in their own banlist or as
  non-structural verb usage. 'invocation' present only as qualified
  non-structural usage (subprocess invocation, model invocation,
  CLI invocation, complete invocation), per §2.1's allowance.
- Non-goals visibly absent: oversized-output auto-dispatch deferred
  in §3.3, §11, §12 v0.3; handle-based async pinned to v0.4 in
  §2.5/§12; subagent dispatch pinned to v0.4 in §12.
